description.text: The School of Mechanical Engineering is a well-known school nationally in China, with its comprehensive strength and international influence at the top of domestic schools and some of its research at the leading edge internationally.The school has an annual funding of more than $200 million and has established a wide range of personnel training and scientific research cooperation agreements with domestic and foreign famous automobile enterprises.Laboratories including the National Laboratory for Tank Transmission Technology, the National Engineering Laboratory for Electric Vehicles, the Laboratory for Vehicle Power Technology, the Testing Laboratory for Vehicle Emission, and the National Engineering Training Center.The school mainly Researches areas of vehicle transmission, electronic vehicles, vehicle suspension, new concept vehicles, vehicle structure strength and vibration noise, high power diesel engine technology, engine combustion and emissions, engine superchargers, advanced machining. The research on laser micro-nano fabrication leads research in China and vehicle transmission and new concept vehicles research has reached the leading edge internationally.The School offers bachelor programs in Mechanical Engineering and Vehicle Engineering and masters programs in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Energy & Dynamics Engineering, and Transport Engineering.During the undergraduate period, the core subjects including mechanics, mechanical engineering, computer science and technology, and control science and engineering. The discipline studies the field of vehicle products design and production, mechanical engineering machinery products, a large number of mechatronic product manufacturing processes, the applications of electronic and computer technology to achieve design automation, and the creation of the theory and methods.During graduate period, students will systematically master in-depth expert theory from the mechanical engineering, power engineering, the engineering of thermal physics and transportation engineering fields. Moreover, students can work independently and undertake professional, technical, or management work. Graduates will leave BIT competent for teaching and scientific research work in related fields.The school has established joint PHD programs with international partner universities including TU-Berlin, TIT, UMich, UPM, and Newcastle University, and long-term academic communication with institutes and universities, such as the University of Wisconsin–Madison, the University of Miami, UC Berkeley, Purdue University, Imperial College London, Bauman Moscow State Technical University, and the University of Tokyo.

duration.text: The Mechatronical Engineering at Beijing Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Application materials*1. Passport (photo page; If you have a Chinese visa before, you also need to upload a Chinese visa page)*2. High school transcript (notarized, Chinese or English version required)*3. High school diploma (notarized, Chinese or English version required)*4. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (Chinese teaching :HSK Level 5 >180, English teaching: IELTS >6.0/ TOEFL >85 or other equivalent language proficiency certificate recognized by our school, native English speakers do not need to provide proof of English proficiency)*5. Personal Statement/Study Plan 6. Application Form for BlT Undergraduate Freshmen Scholarship 7. Applicants under the age of 18 are required to upload Materials 8.Physical Examination Record for Foreigner.9. Fund guarantee certificate (deposit certificate issued by bank)10. No criminal certificate (to be issued at the local police station)11. Other attachments (at least 2 works of art are required to apply for the major of the School of Design and Art)

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above who is qualifed to apply for university, non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passport and in goodhealth; observe Chinese laws and regulations of Beijing Institute ofTechnology.2. Aged between 18 and 25; Applicants under 18 should provide certificate of guardian who has Beiing residency.3. Applicants must comply with the regulations (Jw [2020)No. 12) issued by Ministry of Education of People's Republic of china.
